about: {name} is a B2B company that plans educational trips for schools.
description: {name} case study: a school travel website with Journeys and Safety pages and a school enquiry form, designed and built by the MMC team.
brief: {name} plans trips for schools. We built its website: a homepage, a Journeys page, a Safety page for parents and staff, and a school enquiry form.
The site is organised into Journeys, Safety and a school enquiry form, and the enquiry form is the one action it points to.

showcases.title: Homepage on desktop and mobile
showcases.text: A full-width group photograph in the hero, a clear route to join, and a phone version that keeps the same headline and a Plan a school tour button.

showcases.title: Two pages for the people who decide
showcases.text: Journeys sorts trips into themes. Safety sets out supervision, transport, medical preparedness and parent updates for staff and parents.

showcases.title: School enquiry form
showcases.text: School name, contact person, city, age group, preferred journey and group size, ending in a single Request tour plan button.

flow.site: Homepage, Journeys page and Safety page
flow.reach: Search and direct visits to the site

alts.hero: {name} website, ads and social creative shown together
